findings.finding: The adapter reads the pinned HSO parent catalog, but it does not fetch or hash the 23 child repositories or each release package. Parent-catalog pinning does not prove that each child source remains accessible or matches the catalog metadata.
findings.disposition: Keep child source state CANDIDATE until a separate bounded, allowlisted child-repository verifier captures exact commit and content digest.

findings.finding: Several catalog entries have undeclared, restricted, private-not-cleared or non-commercial usage terms. A.S.F.R.E.E is marked PolyForm Noncommercial; Skill Analyzer's repository license was not declared. No bulk install, redistribution or commercial invocation should be inferred from ecosystem membership.
findings.disposition: Maintain UNDECLARED or RESTRICTED rights. Require explicit legal/owner clearance for intended HSMART use before distribution or runtime invocation.
findings.mitigation: The current read-only discovery adapter always leaves capability eligibility BLOCKED and never exposes invocation or distribution operations. This is a preventive control for the current PR scope, not evidence that the underlying legal/runtime prerequisite is satisfied.

findings.finding: The HSO runtime catalog records one narrowly scoped Skill Analyzer Remote MCP capability with probe status READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS and approval policy ALWAYS, but this does not prove that the current HSMART host can invoke it. The current adapter marks host activation NOT_CONFIGURED and invocation NOT_RUN.
findings.disposition: Do not enable dispatch until a named HSMART host passes authentication, allowlist, protocol handshake, user approval, exact tool discovery and real invocation tests with a receipt.
findings.mitigation: The current read-only discovery adapter always leaves capability eligibility BLOCKED and never exposes invocation or distribution operations. This is a preventive control for the current PR scope, not evidence that the underlying legal/runtime prerequisite is satisfied.

findings.finding: HSO catalog includes three DRIFT_DETECTED entries, two NOT_COMPARED entries, one MATCH, and numerous NOT_APPLICABLE entries. Version alignment includes source/platform lag and platform-only snapshots. These are material provenance differences, not cosmetic metadata.
findings.disposition: Preserve parity and version states. Resolve source/package differences per plugin; never overwrite platform instructions or mark them aligned automatically.

findings.finding: All 15 integration-matrix edges are CONTRACT_TESTED. That status describes the HSO handoff schema/mock contract, not real host activation or plugin runtime execution.
findings.disposition: Do not use compatibility edge state as invocation evidence. Add separate target-host and real-runtime receipts when a real integration is enabled.

findings.finding: The adapter pins a known HSO commit, which makes its snapshot reproducible, but it does not automatically follow main or prove that the pinned catalog is the latest approved revision.
findings.disposition: Refresh the pinned catalog only through an explicit versioned update and repeat the six-file integrity checks; retain old revision snapshots for audit.

limitations: This report is correlation-limited and is not independent model/provider certification.
GOV-11 is a designated logical role; a separate GOV-11 runtime is not provisioned.
Tests use synthetic catalog fixtures. They prove local mapping logic, not a live HSMART-to-HSO host transport.
The 23 plugin and 265 skill counts are catalog data at pinned HSO commit 9853bde6d8484b486aa4d163e65f834fa632410b, not an assertion that all entries are executable.
No child repository source hash, license signature, live HSO invocation, HSMART production deployment or PRE write-back was performed.
The successful CI evidence is bound to code-reviewed SHA 16672f1 before this report-only commit; exact final-head CI remains pending.
disposition: PR #35 is technically coherent as a pinned, read-only catalog discovery adapter with conservative, fail-closed readiness semantics. All 288 discovered plugin/skill descriptors must remain BLOCKED until individual source, rights, parity, interface, host and runtime evidence is complete. Keep the PR draft and stacked. Require exact final-head CI and the sole human GOV-01 decision before merge; do not treat HSO catalog presence or CONTRACT_TESTED compatibility edges as permission to execute or distribute. High-severity operational prerequisites are mitigated only for this bounded PR scope by the fail-closed BLOCKED default; they remain explicit, uncleared activation gates and must not be waived.
